summary: Preserved candidate https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2873 at exact commit 19b9f743bf6d251f666f43cc6c165a7d375b3efd and corrected the concrete omissions reproduced from independent review https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2970. Native TextGenerate and Generate now accept image, audio, and video URI or inline-byte inputs and pass them to GenerateReqInput, including alongside disaggregated rendezvous parameters. GetOperationalState exposes accepting-new-requests, draining, ready-to-serve, weight-update-in-progress, and a typed phase. Native and standard health now mean ready to serve: startup, pause/drain, weight update, unhealthy state, and shutdown are not serving.

tests.command: git grep/diff inspection of exact candidate 19b9f743bf6d251f666f43cc6c165a7d375b3efd (reports/j-a32e4955d8ab/failing-before.txt)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: the exact candidate proto contained no image/audio/video fields and no accepting/draining/readiness state; its cumulative changes only implemented standard health behavior.
18 Rust tests passed, including standard-health adversarial cases, aggregated and disaggregated native multimodal conversion, inline byte data-URI conversion, and invalid MIME rejection.
4 tests passed, including pause/drain, weight-update, readiness/resume, startup, unhealthy, and shutdown lifecycle state and health semantics.
All native gRPC targets passed clippy with warnings denied.
Rebuilt the corrected optimized native library at /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-a32e4955d8ab/cargo-target/release/libsglang_grpc_core.so.

Live rebuilt-native wire probe observed SERVING/DRAINING/UPDATING_WEIGHTS/SERVING/NOT_SERVING and verified image, inline audio, video, and disaggregated parameters reached the runtime request dictionary. Raw output is passing-after.txt.

gpu_evidence: No GPU execution was used. The available deterministic tiny Llama fixture is text-only and cannot qualify a multimodal architecture, semantic media correctness, or encoder-disaggregated execution; using it as such would be misleading.
remaining_limitations: No supported multimodal model weights were available, so image/audio/video numerical inference correctness was not measured.

No encoder-disaggregated multimodal deployment was available. Coverage verifies that multimodal data and disaggregated rendezvous parameters coexist through the native wire and conversion path, not distributed KV-transfer execution.

The live native lifecycle probe uses a deterministic RuntimeHandle. Python lifecycle tests bind the state to actual TokenizerManager fields and operations, but no weighted model server under inference load or a production RL trainer was run.
Inline payloads are represented as data URIs at the existing GenerateReqInput boundary; supported media decoding remains model/processor dependent.
